description: NaFe(WO₄)₂ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent WO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-57°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.43 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-57°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.27 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent WO₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-52°. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.15 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent W and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one W and two equivalent Fe atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom.
